"nextHypothesis":"Add one explicit sentence to the artifact-authoring brief stating that STEP_5 `sdd-log authoring-complete` and STEP_1 `sdd-orient` are out of scope when the brief selects bounded template-to-artifact authoring, so the conflict with the owner directive does not have to be re-derived at run time."}
